reviews.x: These are so cute. My little girl is going to be Minnie for Halloween and refuses to wear a headband so these work great. I tried them on and she didn't touch them. They are just the right size to be proportional on my 2 year old. The clips are metal gator clips which I'm not a huge fan of but I glued some ribbon and they are good to go.

reviews.t: If you have a kid that doesn’t like the headbands， then you probably want to get these
reviews.x: Got these for our trip to Disneyland and my 2 yrs old worn it the entire time. So cute. If you have a kid that doesn’t like the headbands， then you probably want to get these.

reviews.t: Great alternative for child who hates headbands!
reviews.x: These are super cute! I purchased for my daughter's Minnie Mouse themed birthday party.  Just wish the ears were a bit smoother... The material is gathered toward the bow so it appears to have little pleats in it. Also would be nice if the clips were a little tighter to grip my toddler's fine hair. As they are, they tend to flop over but I think they will work great if placed in front of banded pigtails.

reviews.t: Adorable! Perfect for my 2 year old
reviews.x: These ears are the cutest mini mouse ears ever! They were perfect for my toddler who won’t leave on the traditional ears on a headband. The clips held up just fine in her very thin, fine hair. She looked adorable and they lasted all day!

These looked amazing and worked great on my 12 month year old. She hates headbands, immediately she will reach and pull them off. But these clips stayed on the whole time. They were very secure. She looked so adorable.
I love these little clips!!! My daughter loves them too!! Once they’re on she refuses to take them off. They’re perfect for her since she can’t keep on headbands for very long.
These Minnie Mouse Ears were perfect for my 9 month old for her first trip to Disneyland. They stay in her hair all day.  Plus they come with little rubber bands. So awesome.

Bought this for my daughters 1st birthday (Minnie mouse themed), when received I love it immediately. On the day of her party I took them out and one of the bows just fell off. I had to find a glue gun to attached back. After trying to replaced on my babies ponytail the band itself fell off. Poorly constructed!  After only one use and the hair clips fell apart.

Bought these for my daughter's Minnie Mouse costume and they were perfect! I went with this style ears instead of a headband because I knew my 2 year old wouldn't keep it on but with these- 2 pig tails and clip these babies in and she didn't bother them a bit and she looked so stinking cute!

I used these in my daughter’s hair during our Disney trip and they were adorable! I put her hair in 2  high buns and clipped 1 in front of each bun. She received tons of compliments from others at the Disney parks as well as attention from the characters! So fun and so cute!

reviews.t: Just what I was looking for
reviews.x: my toddler will not wear headbands. I purchased this for her Twododles theme party. Just what I was looking for. The color is right, pink with white polka dots. The ears stand up straight. They are comfy, she is not tugging at them. Overall happy with my purchase

Perfect for child or adult! I bought them for my daughter for her birthday party and for Disney. They are so much more comfortable than a headband and she doesn't pull these off like she does for headbands. So win win! Highly recommend!

Theses are cheap.... for a reason. Theses are a great concept but very poorly executed. They had chunks of hot glue everywhere and the ring kept popping out from the middle and the bows are a weird faded pink.
Super cute!! Bought these for my two year old’s Minnie Mouse themed Birthday party! She loves them and doesn’t want to take them off! Perfect size and not too big! Pink is true to color!

reviews.t: and worked as a great alternative to a headband
reviews.x: These are the cutest things ever. and worked as a great alternative to a headband. My daughter has fine hair so the black rubber bands included came in handy to secure clips to pigtails.

reviews.t: Clipped on and stayed on all day
reviews.x: Works well for a child that doesn't like a headband in her hair since these are clip on. Worked perfect! My daughter left them on all day. Very cute too. Looked just like the picture.

reviews.t: Cute but didn’t work. Fell apart.
reviews.x: Fell apart within minutes. Total bummer because I needed them for my 2 year old because she won’t leave a headband on. These didn’t even make it to her head. Super sad.

reviews.t: Good for a day or two
reviews.x: I bought these for our trip to Disney. We had a 3 day pass. I would say it lasted for 2 trips until they fell apart. Good for the price. But not good for everyday use.
Too cute, much more easy than a head band that wig be pulled off and can be worn with different hair styles; like braids. Don't put photos of kids out but again cute
My 3 yr old loves it. I love these clips because they have rigged edges to grip to the hair unlike some that are smooth and will fall out easily.
[[VIDEOID:61607f5ee3c03c285c8a5335a8936e9a]] Received the ears today, and one of the clips was broken. Looks like it was smashed.
These were perfect for my baby girl’s Minnie Mouse themed birthday party! She has thin hair, but they stayed in perfectly!

reviews.t: These are going to do their job I just wish ...
reviews.x: These are going to do their job I just wish we would have received the pink ones that are pictured. We ended up with red.
These were the cutest ears my 2 year old daughter loved them. She looks adorable in them. It really met my expectations.
Soo cute! I used it on my 1 year old twins for their first minnie mouse party they stayed on all day. Good quality.

claims.text: Customers frequently praise these as a great alternative for toddlers who refuse to wear headbands, staying on securely.
Many reviewers find the ears adorable and cute, often using them for Minnie Mouse costumes, birthdays, or Disney trips.
Several customers note the clips work well and stay in place, even in fine or thin toddler hair, with included rubber bands helping secure them.
A few reviewers report poor construction, with bows or bands falling off and glue issues.
Some customers mention minor quality concerns like rough ear material, clips not tight enough, or faded color.
